It is understandable that you feel that pressure, especially when you are trying to establish yourself in a new role. The desire to prove your competence can often make it feel like saying "no" is a risk to your reputation.

Since you mentioned that you've been trying to deal with this on your own, what do you think is the biggest hurdle when it comes to setting those boundaries? Is it the fear of how your colleagues will react, or is it more of an internal pressure you're putting on yourself?
